senses.gloss:
हट् हट्, cl. 1. P. हटति, जहाट, हटितुम्,
to shine, be bright.

हटपर्णि हट-पर्णि, n. (according to Śab-
da-k.) the aquatic plant Vallisneria; [cf. हठ-
पर्णी.]

हट्ट हट्ट, अस्, m. a market, fair; (ई), f. a
petty market or fair.
—हट्ट-चौरक, अस्, m. a
thief who steals from fairs and markets.
—हट्ट-
विलासिनी, f. ‘dallying in market-places;’ a wanton
woman, prostitute; a sort of perfume (= धमनी);
turmeric (= हरिद्रा).

हाटक हाटक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. हट्), golden,
made of gold; (अम्), n. gold; the thorn-apple (=
धुस्तूर).
—हाटक-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or
consisting of gold, golden.
—हाटकेश्वर (˚क-
ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a form of Śiva (worshipped on
the banks of the Godāvarī).
